safe_area.description: Full frame is safe. Edges (20px padding) may be cut on some devices. Essential content within 1850x1020.

formats.notes: Standard HD landscape. Optimize for desktop playback. YouTube long-form preferred format.

safe_area.description: Mobile-first. Safe area is center 1040x1890 (content that fits all devices). Avoid UI in top/bottom 100px.

formats.notes: Vertical short-form. Designed for mobile phones. TikTok Shorts require 9:16 aspect ratio. Bitrate optimized for mobile networks.

safe_area.description: Square format. Edges 10px on all sides may be cut. Safe area is center 1060x1060.

formats.notes: Square format for social media feed. Useful for image-heavy content. Can be extracted from 16:9 via center-safe crop or resized from 9:16.

safe_area.description: Instagram feed optimal. Safe area is center 1050x1320. Avoid critical content within 20px of edges.

formats.notes: Instagram feed preferred aspect ratio. Taller than square, shorter than vertical. Optimized for portrait phone screens.

safe_area.description: Lightweight HD. Safe area is center 1250x700. Edges 15px may be cut.

formats.notes: Lower bitrate HD variant for bandwidth-constrained platforms. Useful for X/Bluesky where file size matters. Can be downscaled from 1920x1080.
